card.name: Words introducing a time span
card.fires_on: Small words that come right before a unit of time, such as 'a' in 'once a month', 'period' after a duration, and 'Between' before years. It also fires on 'hours' inside a stated time span.

modes.label: Frequency phrases
modes.description: The word 'a' in once or twice a month or week, just before the time unit.
modes.example: at least once<< a>> month. Control hypertension

modes.label: Duration of a period
modes.description: The word 'period' or 'hours' after a number-of-time phrase, naming a study or dosing span.
modes.example: However, over the 12-week<< period>>, compared with placebo

modes.label: Between before dates or doses
modes.description: The word 'Between' starting a date range or an interval between doses.

card.writes: It seems to push toward time-related nouns and period words, and away from season or term words such as 'season', '学期' and '时期'.
card.plain: It lights up on small words that lead into a length or rate of time, like 'once a month' or 'over the 12-week period'.
